query:
UPDATE email SET state = 'approved', approval_order = (SELECT
             coalesce(max(approval_order), 0) + 1 FROM email previous WHERE previous.task_id =
             email.task_id), html = ?, text = ?, planned_at = ?, updated_at = ?
           WHERE id = ?
             AND task_id = ?
             AND state = 'review'
             AND trim(coalesce(subject, '')) <> ''
             AND trim(coalesce(body_md, '')) <> ''
             AND mentor_id IN (SELECT id FROM mentor WHERE trashed_at IS NULL AND id IN (SELECT
               mentor_id FROM mentor_email))
             AND task_id IN (SELECT id FROM task WHERE state <> 'stopped')
